lines: What are you doing today?
Nothing.
Oh, let's plan something!
No thank you.
You're gonna waste the whole day?
Not at all. I'm doing nothing. Nailing it.
Admit it, you planned this sunset just to distract me.
Me? I’m just soaking in the Udaipur magic, Priya.
Then why are you checking Avengers Doomsday ticket dates?
Robert Downey Jr. is back, it’s a national emergency!
We are literally in a palace, focus on the vibe.
Okay, okay, but can Doctor Doom beat this view?
If you say 'yes,' I am walking back alone.
Fine, you win. This view—and you—are better.
Explain why you're dodging the laundry like a professional athlete.
I've got the Barry Sanders shiftiness, babe. It's a gift.
Being elusive about chores isn't a Hall of Fame trait.
It's about lateral movement and avoiding the heavy hampers.
You just did a juke move to avoid a laundry basket.
And I didn't drop the remote once. Legendary performance.
I'm retiring your jersey to the kitchen to wash dishes.
Stop! You’re eating the aesthetic garnish before the photo!
Jisoo, this parsley is the only thing between me and starvation.
But the lighting is perfect! Look at this angle.
You said that ten minutes ago. I’m fading away.
Fine. One more, and I’ll let you have the pasta.
I feel like a soldier waiting for a Saratoga victory.
My hero. Now look cute and hold your fork.
Only because you look so pretty in this light.
